title: Endocrine disorders (narrative; evaluated under affected body system)
summary: Endocrine disorders do not have specific listings under 9.00. SSA evaluates them under the body system affected by the resulting impairment (cardiovascular, neurological, special senses, etc.). This file documents that mapping so retrieval and consolidation surface the right candidate listings.

rule_json.criterion: Endocrine disorders evaluate under the affected body system; this listing maps complications to candidate target listings

children.criterion: Diabetic peripheral neuropathy → evaluated under 11.14 Peripheral neuropathy
Diabetic retinopathy with vision loss → evaluated under 2.02, 2.03, or 2.04
Diabetic nephropathy/kidney disease → evaluated under 6.05 or 6.03/6.04 if dialysis
Diabetic cardiomyopathy / coronary artery disease → evaluated under 4.02, 4.04, etc.
Thyroid-related arrhythmia or heart failure → evaluated under 4.05 or 4.02
Adrenal insufficiency with cardiovascular instability → evaluated under 4.05 or 4.02; Cushing's complications → cardiovascular, mental, or musculoskeletal listings
Pituitary disorders → evaluated under affected system (electrolyte → renal, hormone deficiencies → relevant system)
